title: Finite-Sample Decision Instability in Threshold-Based Process Capability Approval
summary: Process capability indices such as $C_{pk}$ are widely used in manufacturing quality control to support supplier qualification and product release decisions based on fixed acceptance thresholds (e.g., $C_{pk} \geq 1.33$). In practice, these decisions rely on sample-based estimates computed from moderate sample sizes ($n \approx$ 20-50), yet the stochastic nature of the estimator is often overlooked when interpreting threshold compliance.
